en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, and Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, both together from Ibn Abu Nasr, from Dawood Bin Sirhan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘When he drives in, so the washing has been Obligated, and the whipping, and stoning, and it Obligates the dower’.
en.sarwar: 3. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad and Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from all ibn abu Nasr from Dawud ibn Sarhan who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
If he makes it penetrate, Ghusl (bath), whipping, stoning and mahr (dower) become obligatory.’”
